name: plan-generosity-bosses
about: Controlled Fury boss observations: exact nonempty expected roster and requested/predicted-pick/actual-held/cast-log IDs; actual-held position reads, cost, boss cooldown, buff multipliers and beam metadata. A nonpassive pre-cast IsCasting observation followed by sampled casting zero establishes only pre-active, later suppressed; the skill may end naturally before Fury lands, so no causal interruption credit. All per-attempt observations are retained.
